beats.text: Sefa, who first met you at the very start, is here again where it is hardest. "I said we'd meet once more. You already carry what you need. Use it."

beats.speaker: Veil
beats.text: Veil steps out of the dark and, this time, does not move aside. "No more going around me. Whatever you do next, you do it facing me."
Beside an absent mayor, the thing you feared turns to face you, and it knows your name.
The wind drops all at once, and the whole mountainside holds its breath.
